elsewhere.note: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.
Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
But they didn’t listen or turn their ear, but walked in their own counsels and in the stubbornness of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward.
The sword will fall on their cities, and will destroy the bars of their gates, and will put an end to their plans.
For the statutes of Omri are kept, and all the works of Ahab’s house. You walk in their counsels, that I may make you a ruin, and her inhabitants a hissing…
